title: High Precision Detection of Conserved Segments from Synteny Blocks
author: Joseph MEX Lucas
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.idnca5e

steps.title: Install Required Software
steps.instruction: Install and configure the necessary software dependencies using the provided documentation.

substeps.instruction: Follow the instructions in https://github.com/DyogenIBENS/LibsDyogen/blob/master/README.txt to install LibsDyogen (release v2.0.0-alpha), i-ADHoRe 3.0, and Cyntenator.
Add the main folder of LibsDyogen to the PYTHONPATH.
Follow the instructions in https://github.com/DyogenIBENS/PhylDiag/blob/master/README.txt to install PhylDiag (release v2.0.0-alpha).
Add the main folder of PhylDiag to the PHYLDIAG environment variable.

steps.title: Compare PhylDiag and i-ADHoRe to Simulated Sbs
steps.instruction: Run the comparison script for PhylDiag and i-ADHoRe 3.0 within the PHYLDIAG/data/benchmark folder.

substeps.instruction: Optional: To recompute conserved segments of PhylDiag and base_clusters of i-ADHoRe 3.0 locally, set LOAD_PRECOMPUTED_BENCHMARK = False at the beginning of PHYLDIAG/src/benchmark/comparePhylDiagAndADHORESbsToSimulatedSbs.py.

Execute the following command: PHYLDIAG/src/benchmark/comparePhylDiagAndADHORESbsToSimulatedSbs.py speciesTree.phylTree Mus.musculus Gallus.gallus Amniota -pSimGenomes=genes..list.bz2 -pAncGenes=ancGenes..list.bz2 -pSimulatedSbs=sbs.genes...list.bz2 -preComputePairwiseSbs -oriented

steps.title: Compare Cyntenator to Simulated Sbs
steps.instruction: Run the comparison script for Cyntenator within the PHYLDIAG/data/benchmark folder.

substeps.instruction: Optional: To recompute the RSBs of Cyntenator locally, set LOAD_PRECOMPUTED_BENCHMARK = False at the beginning of PHYLDIAG/src/benchmark/compareCyntenatorSbsToSimulatedSbs.py.

Execute the following command: PHYLDIAG/src/benchmark/compareCyntenatorSbsToSimulatedSbs.py speciesTree.phylTree Mus.musculus Gallus.gallus Amniota -pSimGenomes=genes..list.bz2 -pAncGenes=ancGenes..list.bz2 -pSimulatedSbs=sbs.genes...list.bz2 -preComputePairwiseSbs -oriented
